row.evidence: Procore's support FAQ says "Procore does not support automatic provisioning with SSO at this time"; user accounts must be created in the Directory tool.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). Procore states that automatic provisioning and JIT are not supported; SAML SSO works with Okta, OneLogin, Entra ID, Google and custom SAML IdPs, but users must be created in the Directory tool (manually, by Procore-assisted or self-serve import templates, or via the REST API). Pricing has no public tiers: an annual fee per product based on Annual Construction Volume with unlimited users. June's team plan 'Essentials' and the '~$15K-$80K/yr' estimate have no first-party source and were dropped. The REST API Company Users endpoints (list, create, batch sync, update, invite, reactivate) let customers script user lifecycle, but no IdP provisioning connector built on it is documented.

citations.title: Do I need to create Procore user accounts if our company implements SSO?
citations.quote: User accounts must be created in the Directory tool for everyone who will access your company in Procore. Procore does not support automatic provisioning with SSO at this time.
